name: Exp_ToCloseProfit
summary: This EA monitors the account's floating profit and automatically closes all open positions (both long and short) when the total unrealized profit reaches or exceeds a user-defined threshold. It uses a global variable to track whether the profit level has been triggered, ensuring that once the target is hit, all positions are closed even if profit subsequently drops below the threshold.
summary_zh: 该EA监控账户浮动利润，当总未实现利润达到或超过用户设定的阈值时，自动平掉所有持仓（多头和空头）。它使用全局变量记录利润水平是否已被触发，确保一旦触及目标，即使利润随后回落，所有仓位仍会被平掉。
strategy_analysis: 该EA的核心策略概念是账户级别的利润目标平仓工具，而非传统意义上的交易策略。它没有入场条件，因为它不自行开仓，仅在检测到账户总利润达到设定阈值时触发平仓操作。出场条件是当AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_PROFIT)大于等于MaxProfit参数时，遍历所有持仓并依次平掉多头和空头仓位。仓位管理方面，该EA不涉及仓位建立，仅负责统一平仓，且从PositionsTotal()-1倒序遍历以避免索引错乱。资金管理方面，它使用全局变量（GlobalVariable）来锁定利润触发状态，一旦利润达标即设置标志为1，即使利润回落也会执行平仓，这是一种防止利润回吐的锁仓机制。然而，该EA没有对滑点进行充分控制，平仓时使用固定的10点滑点容忍度，在高波动市场中可能导致平仓失败或成交价格不理想。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of this EA is an account-level profit-target closing utility rather than a traditional trading strategy. It has no entry conditions since it does not open positions on its own; it only triggers closing when the account's total floating profit reaches the configured threshold. The exit condition is triggered when AccountInfoDouble(ACCOUNT_PROFIT) equals or exceeds the MaxProfit parameter, at which point it iterates through all open positions and closes both long and short positions. Regarding position management, the EA is not involved in position establishment and only handles uniform closing, iterating from PositionsTotal()-1 downward to avoid index shifting during deletion. For money management, it uses MetaTrader global variables to lock in the profit trigger state — once profit hits the target, a flag is set to 1, ensuring positions are closed even if profit subsequently drops below the threshold, which acts as a profit-lock mechanism. However, the EA lacks sufficient slippage control, using a fixed 10-point slippage tolerance for closing, which may lead to failed closes or unfavorable execution prices in highly volatile markets.

parameters.name: MaxProfit
parameters.description: 最大利润阈值，当账户浮动利润达到此值时平掉所有持仓
parameters.description_en: Max profit threshold; closes all positions when floating profit reaches this value

pros: 简单直观的利润目标管理工具，逻辑清晰易于理解
使用全局变量锁定利润触发状态，防止利润回吐后错过平仓时机
倒序遍历持仓避免索引错乱，平仓逻辑较为稳健
pros_en: Simple and intuitive profit target management tool with clear, easy-to-understand logic
Uses global variables to lock the profit trigger state, preventing missed closes when profit pulls back
Iterates positions in reverse order to avoid index shifting, making the closing logic reasonably robust
cons: 固定10点滑点容忍度在高波动市场可能不足，导致平仓失败
无持仓筛选机制，平掉所有品种的所有仓位，缺乏灵活性
缺乏错误处理和重试机制，平仓失败后无后续补救措施
依赖外部包含文件TradeAlgorithms.mqh，核心平仓逻辑不可见
cons_en: Fixed 10-point slippage tolerance may be insufficient in volatile markets, causing close failures
No position filtering mechanism — closes all positions across all symbols, lacking flexibility
Lacks error handling and retry logic, with no fallback if close operations fail
Depends on external include file TradeAlgorithms.mqh, making core closing logic opaque
improvements: 增加按品种或魔术号筛选持仓的功能，避免误平其他策略的仓位
添加平仓失败的重试机制和错误日志记录，提高可靠性
improvements_en: Add position filtering by symbol or magic number to avoid accidentally closing positions from other strategies
Add retry logic and error logging for failed close operations to improve reliability

risk_points: 固定滑点容忍度可能导致高波动时平仓失败
无差别平掉所有仓位可能影响其他EA的持仓
risk_points_en: Fixed slippage tolerance may cause close failures during high volatility
Indiscriminate closing of all positions may affect other EAs' holdings
